// diagnostic

E1227

`jet` {jet_version} and `{engine}` {engine_version} disagree.

What

`jet` {jet_version} and `{engine}` {engine_version} disagree.

Why

`jet` and its engine binaries (`jetpack`, `jetos`) ship as one toolchain and must match exactly — a version-skewed engine may not understand what `jet` sends it. `jet` checks this with an `--engine-protocol` handshake before running any engine verb.

Fix

use matching `jet`/`{engine}` versions — reinstall the toolchain so both binaries come from the same release.
